entries.title: Custom Words: replacement pairs ('Owen -> Eoin')
highlights: Teach GeminiFlow how to replace words you say with the spelling you want: type a pair such as 'Owen -> Eoin' directly in the Custom Words window (or enter it in custom-words.json).
Replaces whole words and phrases across all transcription engines ('Owen' and 'Owen's' change; 'Owens' and 'Bowen' stay untouched) and biases the spelling in Gemini Live.

entries.title: Custom Words: names and unusual terms spelled your way
highlights: A list of up to 100 names and unusual terms is sent to Google's speech model with each dictation so it writes them the way you do (in testing 'Shavon' became 'Siobhan'). If the service ever refuses the list, dictation carries on without it.

On the Mac, edit the list from the Custom Words menu item. It is stored outside the project folder and applies from your next dictation. Keep it to names and unusual terms: a listed everyday word replaces its sound-alikes.

entries.title: Sturdier Setup, Changelog and API key windows
highlights: First run asks for Speech Recognition and the microphone at the right moments, the API key box only accepts something that looks like a key and shows the saved key masked, and closing a window hands you back to the app you were typing in.

Buttons need a press and release on the same spot, the search box clears with its X or Esc, long changelog titles no longer overlap, VoiceOver can read both windows, and test runs no longer flash extra icons in the menu bar.
An update no longer restarts the app while you are dictating: it waits until your text has been delivered.

entries.title: Long dictations stay on Live when the last sound is only a click or a breath
highlights: After a pause in a long dictation, a key click or breath just before release no longer throws away the text Live already returned and sends the whole recording to the slower backup.
The text is finished on Live only when the audio after the last answered part has no speech in it; anything that could be a word still goes to the backup, so nothing said is lost.

entries.title: Repeated phrases and mid-thought restarts cleaned up
highlights: Keeps one copy when a phrase is said twice in a row while you gather a thought ('with my with my new app', 'I would I would', 'will do will do'), and when you restart after one dropped word ('I also want you to give some I also want you to give updates').
Leaves deliberate repeats alone: emphasis after a comma ('I know, I know'), courtesy phrases, names, number runs and idioms such as 'again and again'. Runs on your Mac in well under a millisecond.

entries.title: Brand refresh shared with GeminiFlow for iOS & cleaner windows
highlights: Adopted the iOS brand mark (three slanted bars) for the menu bar icon and the in-app icon, and the GeminiFlow wordmark typography in window headers.
Moved the Changelog and Setup titles below the window buttons and removed the trailing dots from menu items and buttons.

entries.title: Mac-native Changelog (Cmd+L), closable Setup window (Cmd+P) & iOS sync
highlights: Added a clean, flat Mac-native Changelog window (Cmd+L, Cmd+W, Esc) with inline titlebar search, Engine filter, collapsible timeline, and canonical changelog.json for iOS sync.

Replaced the modal Permissions alert with a closable Setup & Permissions window (Cmd+P) featuring live API key, Microphone, Accessibility, Speech, and Fn-key status indicators plus API key paste sanitization.

entries.title: Silent-press prompt-echo guard & low-evidence silence net
highlights: Stopped silent presses with 1 to 4 stray on-device noise characters from pasting echoed REST instructions ('Transcribe and clean up this audio dictation.').
Instructed the REST fallback model to return an empty result on silence or background noise and routed empty low-evidence responses cleanly to No speech.

entries.title: Noise-relative silence detection & REST plausibility safety net
highlights: Measured speech evidence relative to each press's 20th-percentile room noise floor so quiet-room taps and holds end immediately as No speech instead of calling REST.
Added a numbers-only REST plausibility net rejecting hallucinated zero-timestamps ('00:00') and runaway text lengths on silent audio.

entries.title: Zero word loss across slow split turns
highlights: Held voiced audio (with 0.3s pre-roll) behind any in-flight split turn until generationComplete arrives instead of reopening early after 1.5s, eliminating dropped seam words.
Raised the T26 multi-close hands-free recall gate from 0.95 to 0.99.

entries.title: Hands-free HUD indicator redesign
highlights: Replaced the outer mint rim and glow in locked hands-free mode with a crisp 7px green indicator dot on a soft inner halo and solid green waveform bars inside the pill.
Kept hold-to-talk, Thinking, and notice pill renders pixel-identical.

entries.title: Planned Live session rotation before the 10-minute server cap
highlights: Proactively rotates the Gemini Live WebSocket at the first quiet split point after 8.5 minutes with zero resent audio and zero seam duplicates.
Treats server closes after 9.5 minutes (or after goAway) as planned rotations that do not consume the 2-reconnect drop budget.

entries.title: Accurate 4-gram duplicate-phrase test gate
highlights: Updated duplicated_phrases() in the test runner to flag 4-grams only when they appear at least twice in the output and more often than in expected text, eliminating false positives on minor recognizer phrasing variants.

entries.title: 5- and 10-minute marathon dictation suite & privacy-safe press stats
highlights: Added opt-in 5-minute and 10-minute continuous Live dictation gates (T23) and scaled the e2e watchdog for multi-minute sessions.
Logged one numbers-only Press stats line per dictation (audio duration, Live session age, reconnects, and activity count).

entries.title: Visual distinction for locked hands-free HUD & offscreen PNG renderer
highlights: Added visual differentiation between hold-to-talk and double-tap locked hands-free mode on the floating HUD pill.
Added --render-hud-png for deterministic 2x offscreen HUD verification.

entries.title: Release-cushion telemetry & atomic test audio cache
highlights: Logged numbers-only Fn-up release cushion coverage (hostTime reach past key release and post-release RMS) to measure real hardware buffer lag.
Made test runner TTS and WAV cache writes atomic so interrupted runs never leave truncated audio fixtures.

entries.title: Instant completion when releasing Fn between Live turns
highlights: Finished Live dictations immediately on key release (~135ms instead of ~570ms) when all prior speech was already finalized at a pause split and no uncovered speech remains.

entries.title: Last-sentence question punctuation & filler-like cleanup
highlights: Judged trailing '?' vs '.' from the final sentence rather than earlier clauses in multi-sentence dictations.
Removed stray filler 'like' immediately preceding a stripped 'kind of' or 'sort of' hedge.

entries.title: Context-aware 'kind of' and 'sort of' filler removal
highlights: Stripped 'kind of' and 'sort of' only when set off as spoken pauses or adjacent to vocal fillers, preserving meaningful uses like 'what kind of car' and 'sort of works'.

entries.title: Pronoun capitalization, mixed-case brands & grammatical doubles
highlights: Protected 'i.e.', dotfiles ('.env'), URLs, and mixed-case names ('iPhone', 'macOS') during capitalization and punctuation cleanup.
Collapsed single-word stutters ('the the', 'I I') while keeping grammatical doubles ('had had', 'that that', 'very very').

entries.title: Header-only API key auth & automatic log redaction
highlights: Moved Gemini API key authentication from query URLs into the x-goog-api-key request header across Live WebSocket and REST calls.
Added defensive secret scrubbing in GFLog and static binary/request verification (T19).
